use_case_summary: Zenara runs a latency-sensitive fintech product combining support chat and real-time transaction reranking. Baseline steady-state QPS ~80 (short chat queries), expected peak QPS up to 420 during settlement windows; typical response lengths 40-250 tokens. Primary goals are: 1) derive reserved GPU counts to guarantee throughput and p95/p99 latency targets, 2) decide on model mix and fallback routing, 3) negotiate SLA language for tail latency and capacity guarantees. Workshop should produce: baseline QPS matrix, tokens/sec estimates per model, peak vs steady-state GPU reservation plan, autoscaling/burst policy recommendations, and recommended quantization/config profiles to hit cost targets.
